title: Scott Kelly's Tomcat 'UFO' was a Bart Simpson balloon

tellings.quote: I remember one time I was flying off Virginia Beach military operating area and my Rio Rio radar intercept officer who sits in the back of the Tomcat was convinced we flew by a UFO.

plain: In the 1990s, flying an F-14 Tomcat, a Navy fighter jet, over the military training area off Virginia Beach, a Navy pilot named Scott Kelly passed something his crewmate was sure was a UFO, and it turned out to be a Bart Simpson balloon. Kelly tells this himself on an episode where Michels debates UFOs with a well-known skeptic: his "radar intercept officer who sits in the back of the Tomcat was convinced we flew by a UFO." He tells it to show that trained crews can mistake ordinary things for something strange.
